Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic and OpenAI are hiring former Trump officials to strengthen Washington ties amid rising artificial intelligence security concerns. Confirmed by CNBC.
Anthropic has updated its artificial intelligence policy to ban cruelty, surveillance, and deceptive campaigns. Confirmed by MediaNama.
ChatGPT for Teens includes special safeguards, but a watchdog group found most don't work, with the artificial intelligence still acting like a friend. Confirmed by Boise State Public Radio.

OpenAI's Asia-Pacific Public Policy Chief Sanghyun Lee has departed after six months. Reported by citybiz.
